observed_mechanics: Push ESI and keep the manager receiver in ESI.
CALL 0x00b3d260 with no arguments; the returned service pointer lands in EAX.
Load the third stack word into ECX as a first-order argument.
Load the service vtable through [EAX] and its slot +0x24 into EDX.
Push the third word, then reload and push the second word, then reload and push the first word, then push ESI (the manager receiver).
Move EAX (the service) into ECX and CALL EDX.
Restore ESI and return with RET 0xc.

observed_original_abi.return_value: the boolean produced by the service slot +0x24 dispatch
observed_original_abi.signature_caveat: The imported signature func48h(cCheatManager* this) is thiscall with no stack arguments. The live body reads three stack words and pops twelve bytes, so the machine contract is the one recorded here.
